title: G2 Product Reviews Input
description: Pull public G2 product pages and review snippets without a login. Paste product URLs and run.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: List of G2 product URLs whose facts and reviews you want to scrape. Accepts product overview, /reviews, /pricing, or /features URLs. Examples: 'https://www.g2.com/products/notion/reviews', 'https://www.g2.com/products/figma/reviews'.

includeReviews.title: Include review snippets
includeReviews.description: Pull recent public review snippets from the Reviews page. Each entry ships title, rating, pros, cons, role, industry, company size, and date when present.

reviewsPerProduct.title: Review snippets per product
reviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum number of review snippets to pull per product from the first Reviews page.

includeFeatures.title: Include top features
includeFeatures.description: Pull the top features and most-mentioned pros and cons that G2 surfaces from the public review aggregate.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of products processed in parallel. Higher concurrency runs faster but increases proxy and detection risk. Three is a safe default for G2.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for G2 at any meaningful volume.
